judged_text: sendAddGuestsEmails pushes an OrganizerAddGuestsEmail with no teamMember (organizer) and then loops over `calendarEvent.team.members` sending one per member with no exclusion of the organizer, so the organizer receives the same email twice when they are a team member. Organizers of team bookings get duplicate 'Guests Added' notifications on every guest addition; drift risk if member list already includes the organizer by construction.

adjudication.rationale: In `sendAddGuestsEmails` (packages/emails/email-manager.ts), it always enqueues an organizer notification via `new OrganizerAddGuestsEmail({ calEvent: calendarEvent })`, and then, if `calendarEvent.team?.members` exists, it loops all `team.members` and enqueues `new OrganizerAddGuestsEmail({ calEvent: calendarEvent, teamMember })` for each member without deduplication/excluding the organizer. If the organizer is present in `calendarEvent.team.members`, they will receive two organizer emails for the same guest-add event.
